usageNote: 动词短语，户外活动/自然课常用！collect就是'收集'，超日常～

examples.en: We went to the park to collect the different types of leaves for our science project.
examples.zh: 我们去公园收集不同种类的树叶，用于我们的科学项目。

examples.en: My daughter loves to collect the different types of leaves every autumn.
examples.zh: 我女儿每年秋天都喜欢收集各种不同的树叶。
